parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the ENS edge zones. You can specify up to 100 IDs.

parameters.name: Ipv6Address
parameters.description: The IPv6 addresses of the ENI. You can specify up to 100 addresses.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the elastic network interface (ENI).

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the ENIs. You can specify up to 100 IDs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: PrimaryIpAddress
parameters.description: The primary IP address of the ENI.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group associated with the secondary ENI. Specify this parameter to query secondary ENIs by security group ID.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the ENI. Valid values:

- Available: available.

- Attaching: being attached.

- InUse: in use.

- Detaching: being detached.

- Deleting: being deleted.

If you do not specify this parameter, ENIs in all states are queried.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the ENI. Valid values:

- Primary: primary network interface.

- Secondary: secondary ENI.

If you do not specify this parameter, ENIs of all types are queried.
